name: Joint Seat Allocation Authority
conducting_body: Ministry of Education, Government of India
scope: Centralised seat allocation for IITs, NITs, IIEST, IIITs, and Other-GFTIs based on JEE (Advanced) and JEE (Main) ranks

participating_institutes.iits: 23 IITs — admission based on JEE (Advanced) rank
participating_institutes.nits: 31 NITs — admission based on JEE (Main) rank through JoSAA/CSAB
participating_institutes.other_gftis: Other Government-Funded Technical Institutes — based on JEE (Main)

rounds: Typically 6 rounds of seat allocation (Round 1 to Round 6), followed by a special round if vacancies remain

business_rules.choice_filling: Candidates register on JoSAA portal and fill choices in order of preference across all participating institutes and programmes
business_rules.seat_acceptance: After each round, candidates must accept the allocated seat and pay the seat acceptance fee to confirm

freeze_float_slide.freeze: Accept the offered seat and do not participate in further rounds
freeze_float_slide.float: Accept the offered seat but remain eligible for a better preferred choice in subsequent rounds
freeze_float_slide.slide: Accept the offered seat but remain eligible for a better preferred programme in the SAME institute

business_rules.withdrawal: Candidates can withdraw before the last round; partial refund rules apply
business_rules.physical_reporting: After the final round, candidates must report physically to the allotted institute with original documents

seat_matrix.description: Seat matrix is published before each counselling round, showing category-wise and programme-wise seats in each institute
seat_matrix.note: Exact numbers change every year; always refer to the official seat matrix on josaa.nic.in

eligibility.jee_advanced: Candidates who have qualified JEE (Advanced) and meet all eligibility criteria are eligible for IITs
eligibility.jee_main: Candidates who have appeared in JEE (Main) are eligible for NITs, IIITs, IIEST, and Other-GFTIs

reservation_horizontal: 5% horizontal reservation for PwD within each category

contact.helpdesk: Available on the JoSAA portal during active counselling periods
